about: Open swatch.png with your file read tool and tell me its colour. Don't run commands. A file read whose result is an image, then the answer.

known.reason: Devin 3000.10.23 replays a finished call on session/load as the call and a bare `completed` update, without the result it sent live. A question's picks and a quiet command's exit come back from the update's `_meta` (`DEVIN_ACP_HOOKS.restated`); nothing in a read's update says how many lines it showed. Devin.app reloads a session by replacing its journal with that replay (`endReplay` mode `replace`), so the journal holds the same. Devin's CLI store keeps the result.
